name: HOV Lane
spec: white vertical rectangle with a black diamond symbol and black legend HOV 2+ ONLY
meaning: Only vehicles with the posted minimum number of people may use this lane.

snippets.back: Public transportation, bicycling, walking or carpooling can reduce vehicle operating costs.
HOV lanes are marked by white diamonds painted in the roadway.
Never cross double solid yellows save HOV entrances, signed closures, lefts and U-turns over one set; twin sets two-plus feet apart bar all but gap crossings.
A white diamond can mark an HOV lane or another restricted lane, so read the sign to learn who may use it.
Reserved lanes announce themselves by signs and white diamonds, transit or bus for buses alone, bicycle for bikes alone, and diamond HOV lanes for cars meeting the posted rider count.
The recommended emergency kit includes first-aid supplies, extra clothing, boots, a blanket, sand, a shovel and food.
At the posted times on weekdays, a vehicle carrying fewer than two persons, counting the driver, may not use an HOV lane, which is then reserved for car pools, motorcycles and buses.

A lone solid yellow center line forbids passing only when your direction holds a single lane and that line sits on your side, whereas double solid yellow lines forbid every crossing except HOV entrances, signed detours, and left turns or U-turns over one set. Twin sets spaced two or more feet apart form a barrier no turn may cross except at openings.
